name: Coir Udyami Yojana
summary: A credit-linked capital subsidy scheme for setting up new coir processing units, administered by the Coir Board as the nodal agency for the coir sector.
administering_ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
benefit_description: Margin money subsidy of up to 25% (higher for special categories) of the project cost for setting up new coir units, along with bank credit for the balance.

criteria.description: The applicant's enterprise must be in the coir processing sector.
criteria.source_quote: Coir Udyami Yojana will be a Central Sector Scheme to be administered by the Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises. The Scheme will be implemented by Coir Board a statutory organization under the Ministry of MSME as the Nodal Agency at the national level.

criteria.description: Applicant must be an individual, self-help group, NGO, cooperative society or company setting up a new coir processing unit, and be able to arrange the balance project financing through a bank loan.

document_requirements.how_to_obtain: Prepare a project report covering machinery, output capacity and financial projections for the coir processing unit.
Apply for a term loan to cover the balance project cost not covered by the margin money subsidy.
Provide proof of legal entity status appropriate to the applicant type (individual, SHG, NGO, cooperative or company).

windows.notes: Applications accepted year-round through Coir Board regional offices.

benefits.description: Margin money subsidy on project cost for new coir processing units.
benefits.conditions_for_disbursement: Subsidy held as a term deposit and adjusted against the bank loan after the unit is verified operational.
